extracted.name: Walnut Date Balls
extracted.description: These walnut date balls are sugar-free, vegetarian, and easily made. Perfect little snacks to share anytime.
instruction_lines: Process walnuts, dates, coconut, sesame oil, sea salt, and vanilla extract together in a food processor until combined. Roll date mixture into bite-size balls; refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour.
